outputs.explanation: Panel A is a domain-map schematic combined with raw western blot images, not a plot of averaged data.

Bar charts show single densitometry-quantified values (% depletion, log2 elution) per antibody derived from the blots in (A); no error bars or indication of averaged replicates are present, so this is not an averaged summary statistic requiring individual data points.
Panel C is a heatmap, which is exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel D consists of violin plots, which already display the full data distribution and are exempt.
Bar charts show mean ± SD (n=4) with individual replicate data points overlaid as dots on each bar.
Panel F is a sequence alignment and a predicted molecular structure image, not a data plot.
Panel G is a scatterplot, where individual points are the data itself; exempt from the requirement.
Panel H is a scatterplot with individual IP-MS experiments plotted directly; exempt.
Panel I is a PCA scatterplot showing individual samples directly; exempt.
Panel J is a set of PCA scatterplots showing individual samples directly; exempt.
